suit_type: For money payable for money lent.
starts_from: When the loan is made.

suit_type: For money payable for money paid for the use of the plaintiff at his request.
starts_from: When the money is paid.

suit_type: For money payable by the defendant to the plaintiff for money received by the defendant for the plaintiff's use.
starts_from: When the money is received.

suit_type: For the price of goods sold and delivered.
starts_from: When the goods are delivered.

suit_type: For the price of work done by the plaintiff at the request of the defendant.
starts_from: When the work is done.

suit_type: On a promissory note or bond payable by installments.
starts_from: The expiration of the first term of payment as to the part then payable; and for the other parts, the expiration of the respective terms of payment.

suit_type: On a promissory note or bond payable by installments, which provides that, if default be made in payment of one or more installments, the whole shall be due.
starts_from: When the default is made, unless where the payee or obligee waives the benefit of the provision and then when fresh default is made in respect of which there is no such waiver.

suit_type: For specific performance of a contract.
starts_from: The date fixed for the performance, or, if no such date is fixed, when the plaintiff has notice that performance is refused.

suit_type: For compensation for the breach of any contract, express or implied not herein specially provided for.
starts_from: When the contract is broken or (where there are successive breaches) when the breach in respect of which the suit is instituted occurs or (where the breach is continuing) when it ceases.

suit_type: For a declaration of the forgery of an instrument issued or registered.
starts_from: When the issue or registration becomes known to the plaintiff.

suit_type: To obtain any other declaration.
starts_from: When the right to sue first accrues.

suit_type: To cancel or set aside an instrument or decree or for the rescission of a contract.
starts_from: When the facts entitling the plaintiff to have the instrument or decree cancelled or set aside or the contract rescinded first become known to him.
division: Suits relating to decrees and instruments

suit_type: To enforce payment of money secured by a mortgage or otherwise charged upon immovable property.
starts_from: When the money sued for becomes due.

suit_type: For possession of immovable property or any interest therein based on title.
starts_from: When the possession of the defendant becomes adverse to the plaintiff.

suit_type: By a landlord to recover possession from a tenant.
starts_from: When the tenancy is determined.

suit_type: For specific movable property lost, or acquired by theft, or dishonest misappropriation or conversion.
starts_from: When the person having the right to the possession of the property first learns in whose possession it is.

suit_type: By a principal against his agent for movable property received by the latter and not accounted for.
starts_from: When the account is, during the continuance of the agency, demanded and refused or, where no such demand is made, when the agency terminates.

suit_type: Other suits by principals against agents for neglect or misconduct.
starts_from: When the neglect or misconduct becomes known to the plaintiff.

suit_type: Any suit for which no period of limitation is provided elsewhere in this Schedule.
starts_from: When the right to sue accrues.
division: Suits for which there is no prescribed period

suit_type: Under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, to have the legal representative of a deceased plaintiff or appellant or of a deceased defendant or respondent, made a party.
starts_from: The date of death of the plaintiff, appellant, defendant or respondent as the case may be.

suit_type: To any court for the exercise of its powers of revision under the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908, or the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898.
starts_from: The date of the decree or order or sentence sought to be revised.

suit_type: For the execution of any decree (other than a decree granting a mandatory injunction) or order of any Civil Court.
starts_from: When the decree or order becomes enforceable or where the decree or any subsequent order directs any payment of money or the delivery of any property to be made at a certain date or at recurring periods, when default in making the payment or delivery in respect of which execution is sought, takes place.

suit_type: Any other application for which no period of limitation is provided elsewhere in this division.
starts_from: When the right to apply accrues.
